name: Tridentscourge
description: Open with all three tines aimed along the line from throat to belly in one smooth thrust.

name: Unbowed Tridentshaft
description: Hold the haft across both shoulders as a paired guard against cuts from either side.

name: Phantom Socketbase
description: Slide along the low ground of the stance with the feet kept wide and soft.

name: Triplescourge
description: Descend onto the guard like a hawk with the center prong carrying a hard core of qi.

name: Rumble Pinch
description: Intercept two attacks at once by catching each in a separate notch of the fork.

name: Unseen Gaff
description: Pivot on the lead heel through a flowing curve to put the opponent on the unguarded side.

name: Ironfork
description: Send three needles of qi from the three tines to strike one spot together.

name: Trionerve
description: Hold the trident overhead and spread a shadow of qi that blunts every blow from above.

name: Brutalizing Triprong
description: Plunge the fork through a whole guard in one qi-hardened drive that opens the shield and the body behind it.

name: Booming Forktine
description: Open the exchange with a thrust at the guard answered at once by a matched thrust from the other hand.

name: Adamantine Triplehead
description: Cross both forearms over the haft so that each hand turns away one cut of a pair.

name: Gust Midtine
description: Advance with each step matched by the reach of the opposite hand.

name: Indomitable Prongroot
description: Draw back to the edge of the stance and shield behind the fork while the opponent overreaches.

name: Facet Fork
description: Enter with the two outer tines first so that the center prong follows through the opened wound.

name: Sidetine Fortitude
description: Bind a weapon by closing both outer tines and answer with the center prong aimed at the wrist.

name: Gust Hookbarb
description: Weave the haft in a figure that both hands carry together to turn aside a flurry.

name: Deedtrio
description: Lay a qi trap at the center of the court and spring it by answering the first step into it with a thrust.

name: Lottrident
description: Press two tines against the flat of a blade and seal it from movement with qi held across both.

name: Indomitable Barbtine Spine
description: Answer an incoming thrust with an equal thrust of qi that sends its force back along the same line.

name: Forkwrath
description: Lunge along the first track with the center prong while the guard hand keeps the second track free.

name: Hoarfrost Midtine
description: Block on the second track with the haft held crosswise to the first.

name: Granite Barbtine
description: Step from the first track to the second by a half pivot on the rear foot.

name: Tempered Prongdrive
description: Strike on both tracks at once with an outer tine on each line.

name: Tridentvalor
description: Interlock the two tracks in a single parry that carries a blade clear of both.

name: Pinchruin
description: Rise along the high track with the butt into the chin as the tines fall on the low track.

name: Triplenerve
description: Bracket an opponent's lead leg between two tines and hold it while the center prong stays free.

name: Shattering Gig
description: Split a single thrust into two qi lines that strike separate points on the body.

name: Rumble Socketbase
description: Cross from one track to the other in a flash and appear at the opponent's side with the tines levelled.

name: Hoarfrost Triprong
description: Stand on the rim of the stance with weight sunk and the tines raised like a hawk's talons.

name: Sanguine Prongroot
description: Pitch the body forward in a stoop thrust that brings the tines onto the shoulder from above.

name: Dazzling Gig
description: Circle on the toes around the opponent as a hawk circles overhead.

name: Murk Tridentshaft
description: Catch a low thrust in the basin of the fork and lift it clear.

name: Thorn Triplehead
description: Close the outer tines on a limb and drive it down into the ground.

name: Blaze Prongdrive
description: Lift the fork in a qi updraft that throws a lunging opponent's weapon high.

name: Titanic Forktine
description: Bring the haft down in a river-heavy cut that carries the weight of the whole body.

name: Nova Hookbarb
description: Spread a shadow of qi on the ground and spring it on the first foot that crosses.

name: Lot Sidetine
description: Set the tines at the rim and the butt at the floor of the stance and seal the space between against any weapon.

name: Vengeful Fork
description: Dive from a high leap with the whole trident behind a single point that pierces plate armor.

name: Lacerating Hookbarb
description: Jab with each hand taking its turn at the haft so that the point never rests.

name: Torrent Socketbase
description: Roll the haft between the hands so that it turns cuts away like water against a stone.

name: Torrent Prongroot
description: Step in a tight eddy around the lead foot so that the stance turns and holds.

name: Gigwrath
description: Rake with the left and right outer tines in quick succession across the same wound.

name: Rumble Gaff
description: Draw the fork around a weapon in a small eddy and wrench it from the grip.

name: Adamantine Midtine
description: Retreat with the guard held steady as a stream keeps its banks.

name: Gust Triplehead
description: Run two currents of qi along the outer tines and cut through a guard with both together.

name: Thorntriple
description: Whirl qi in a small eddy about the opponent's front foot so that it drags the step off line.

name: Webbing Lot Seize
description: Close all three tines about a weapon and seal both it and the arm behind it with a deep steady current.

name: Blazetrio
description: Thrust with the discipline of paired hands so that no force is wasted and the points stay level.

name: Silt Gaff
description: Advance by measured paired steps that never leave the guard open.

name: Murk Forktine
description: Rank the three tines to meet a flurry and turn each blow aside in order.

name: Aegis Barbtine
description: Hold the pivot foot rooted while the haft takes a hard shove from the front.

name: Grievous Tridentshaft
description: Feed qi from the whole meridian net into the center prong for a deep drive.

name: Invincible Forktine
description: Shift the weight from one foot to the other in the middle of a parry so that the blade slides clear.

name: Gyvetriple
description: Pin a limb under the fork and hold it there with steady qi from the whole body.

name: Triomettle
description: Hold a hovering qi trap above the stance and drop it on the first reach made toward the wielder.

name: Strangling Gig
description: Seal both of an opponent's hands against the haft by pressing the fork and the butt together with qi.

name: Decimating Sidetine
description: Drive two streams of qi through the fork and bring them to a single lancing point at full reach.

name: Mightpinch
description: Thrust along one sworn line without leaving it so that the point arrives exactly where it was sent.

name: Charter Barbtine
description: Hold the haft on the windward side so that the wind's own force helps brace the guard.

name: Gust Fork
description: Step to the very edge of the opponent's reach and hold there with the tines levelled.

name: Iron Seize
description: Thrust twice along the one sworn line before the first return so that the second drives through the first wound.

name: Chimetrident
description: Whirl the haft in a squall of qi that flings off missiles and light cuts alike.

name: Numbing Pinch
description: Break the opponent's bearing with a sharp push on the side of the blade and strike back through the gap.

name: Silt Triprong
description: Stretch a net of qi across the wind's path that tangles whoever runs through it.

name: Overbearing Seize
description: Press the fork against a guard under sworn weight that bears down for as long as the oath is held.

name: Tripleruin
description: Loose a single thrust that does not waver whatever strikes the haft on its way and drives through full plate.

name: Unconquered Triplehead
description: Stand square on a plateau's edge with the wind at the back and the tines raised.

name: Decimating Prongdrive
description: Lunge along the lip of an edge with the toes finding the last firm ground.

name: Phantom Hookbarb
description: Sidle along a steep scarp keeping the fork between the body and the drop.

name: Impervious Socketbase
description: Turn the haft at the edge of the guard to send a cut out over the drop.

name: Blaze Prongroot
description: Root both feet in the stone and shove the opponent toward the edge with the fork.

name: Granite Seize
description: Rake upward with a gust beneath the tines so that the cut carries on to the chin.

name: Triplespine
description: Hook the barb round a ledge or stone lip and haul the body along it.

name: Deed Sidetine
description: Hide a snare of qi along the scarp path that grips the foot that lands on it.

name: Fastening Pinch
description: Seal the opponent's step at the edge by pressing the fork on the lead knee until the stance cannot move.

name: Facet Gig
description: Drive the fork down in a falling blow that carries the force of a drop from height through three points.

name: Triprong Nerve
description: Hold the fork before the chest on open ground where no wall guards the back.

name: Torrent Gaff
description: Advance in a wide arc that never presents the back to any one foe.

name: Irontrident
description: Thrust straight through the place where a barred gate would stand and keep the haft low.

name: Rumbleseize
description: Slip the tines through the gap between two guards on a gust of qi and thrust.

name: Granite Pinch
description: Sweep the fork round in a ring that holds back all who press too close.

name: Mayhem Fork
description: Open the lead hand and let the fork roll over a weapon to wrench it loose.

name: Midtine Durance
description: Spin a ring of qi about the stance in place of a wall to turn blows from every side.

name: Predatory Sidetine
description: Seed the open ground with a pitfall of qi that spills the first charging foot into a stumble.

name: Fork Ruin
description: Sweep a wide fan of qi from the fork across open ground and strike every foe it touches.

name: Aegistrio
description: Hold a long bearing on the opponent so that every shift of weight is answered at once.

name: Granite Prongdrive
description: Follow the opponent's bearing step for step with the tines never leaving it.

name: Rumbletrio
description: Sight along the center prong as along a rule and thrust the moment the line is clear.

name: Evergreen Hookbarb
description: Shift the bearing a hand's width to take a thrust on the side tine.

name: Waning Tridentshaft
description: Probe the guard with a light jab and read from the answer where the opponent's weight sits.

name: Gnashing Prongroot
description: Haul the haft back from full reach and drive again along the same bearing without losing line.

name: Unseen Socketbase
description: Slide across the opponent's bearing with the tines held on target so that the line changes sides.

name: Overbearing Midtine
description: Bind the opponent's back foot to the line with qi so that retreat along it fails.

name: Devastating Gig
description: Cast a lance of qi down the long bearing to strike at the full reach of the trident and beyond.

name: Grievous Triprong
description: Keep the fork driving along a single bearing through every parry until the point reaches the body.

name: Hoarfrost Tridentshaft
description: Swear to the guard before any attack and hold the fork up in it without wavering.

name: Gustpinch
description: Step forward on the pledged line and let the rear foot follow without a break.

name: Triplehavoc
description: Reach with the barbed outer tine at the arm that has promised to strike.

name: Suffocating Pinch
description: Turn the fork round a wrist so that the joint locks and the weapon drops.

name: Blistering Seize
description: Draw one breath to gather qi and release it on the second as a single thrust.

name: Equipoise Barbtine
description: Hold a guard in which qi turns every cut to the same side for the length of the breath.

name: Granite Socketbase
description: Plant the haft and stand behind it as a pillar that the qi-braced stance holds against any shove.

name: Triplevalor
description: Press the three tines on three joints of a limb and seal its movement with qi.

name: Charter Triplehead
description: Nullify a qi-charged thrust by meeting it with the sworn fork held at one exact bearing.

name: Unbowed Forktine
description: Stand with the weight low and the fork forward so that the wind passes over the guard.

name: Dazzling Pinch
description: Advance on feet steadied by qi from the whole meridian net so that no step wavers.

name: Corroding Gaff
description: Cut along a bearing with the barbed tine and recover to guard before the answer lands.

name: Equipoise Prongroot
description: Turn the haft on its leeward side and throw a cut off into the wind.

name: Seizevalor
description: Press the fork on a limb with the weight of the body and the push of the wind behind it.

name: Facet Prongdrive
description: Feed qi from the meridian net to the center prong and drive it on a gust.

name: Equipoise Midtine
description: Meet a heavy blow on the fork with the feet set like rock on a plateau and turn it aside.

name: Thorn Triprong
description: Lock a weapon in the fork along the bearing and hold it there with steady qi.

name: Silttrident
description: Open a pitfall of qi in the path of a charge so that the foremost foot is jerked from under it.

name: Lotgig
description: Draw on the whole meridian net to seal a weapon arm along a held bearing against every motion.

name: Decimating Nova Gaff
description: Loose one qi-filled thrust along a held bearing that gathers the gale behind the center prong.
